There is an Emarin in ToM who is a Male Channeler  at the black tower. He is an older gentleman and a former noble. Is this the same Emarin? If so was he ever gentled? Was he gentled by somehow healed? If not, this is a new character.[[User:Joedmd|Joedmd]] 16:58, February 1, 2011 (UTC)
:He isn't a new character. Can't find the interview or interaction right now, but I've been told that Brandon Sanderson has said that this Emarin is not a mistake. It is actually [[Algarin Pendaloan]], using his brother's name as an alias.
